target.statement: VideoZoomer (7B) achieves 68.8 on MLVU dev, a +10.5 gain over Qwen2.5-VL-7B (Table 1).

compute.basis: Reproducing this cell requires the full two-stage SFT+GRPO training of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on 52K long-video QA with multi-turn video-zoom rollouts, plus benchmark inference; no trained checkpoint or training configs are advertised.

blockers: requires training/RL of a 7B multimodal model with 16 rollouts and up to 4 multi-turn tool calls per sample
LongVideoReason training set is 52K long-video QA pairs; long-video storage/processing is disk- and I/O-heavy
cold-start data generation depends on proprietary expert models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-pro)
no released model checkpoint or complete training/eval configs, only a code link
CPU-only 16 GB laptop cannot perform the 7B MLLM training or realistic long-video inference
title: VideoZoomer: Reinforcement-Learned Temporal Focusing for Long Video Reasoning
